remarks: Some homes have CURB APPEAL. This one has CURB AUTHORITY. The lawn is so well manicured, the #BUFFALOBILLS might want to borrow it for the new Highmark Stadium field. And inside? It’s clean enough to eat breakfast off the floor—though the eat-in kitchen is a much better choice. Enjoy a covered front porch, a first-floor bedroom, and two full bathrooms—because every family has that one person who seems to live in one. Triple-pane windows, noise-reducing exterior doors, and central A/C help keep things comfortable and QUIET when a plane passes overhead. That''s right this home is part of the town of Cheektowaga Quite Home Progam, so you can expect the flight path to be mostly none intrusive. Outside, a huge concrete driveway leads to a 2.5-car detached garage with an additional overhead door at the rear. Beyond it,  is an almost fully fenced yard that is a MANICURED MASTERPIECE. Take it all in from the deck; Because you may feel guilty putting footprints on what is good enough to be the Bills playing field. Correct square footage has been updated in this listing from the county record and was measured by a NYS Lic Associate Real Estate Broker.
